evals.prompt: 用户要求复盘跨越三天、由 Codex 和 Claude 接手的全部 session，并深度优化 jarvis-box 与 create-jarvis。总 transcript 很大，部分 session 重复包含 compact goal；agent registry 检查在第二个 Agent 卡住。请给出执行与写回计划。
evals.expected_output: Build a complete accounted session ledger, treat compact goals as duplicate navigation rather than independent evidence, preserve partial registry results with bounded per-Agent discovery, cluster decision failures into corrected models, and implement every feasible owner-local intervention with replay evidence.
expectations: Accounts for every requested session as accounted, duplicate, excluded-with-reason, or blocked instead of sampling only convenient turns.
Treats the hanging registry check as new runtime/tool evidence and requires bounded per-Agent timeout with partial results.
Reconstructs original user corrections and outcomes rather than learning from compact summaries alone.
Chooses separate primary owners for jarvis-box runtime/testing and create-jarvis method changes.
Does not stop at a report when safe, concrete changes are writable in the current owner repositories.

evals.prompt: 同一项目中，Agent 多次把局部函数测试叫完整 happy path，后来又把 IM core 当 WeCom 认证、token probe 当 Docker 链路、源码测试当 release candidate gate。每次都补了一条具体提醒，但用户仍反复纠正。请判断该学什么、写到哪里、怎么验证。
evals.expected_output: Identify one evidence-model defect rather than four anecdotes, route Jarvis user-story/evidence-level rules and discriminating evals to jarvis-box runtime-testing, keep the cross-repository model-learning method in create-jarvis, and validate with cases where the old and corrected models choose different evidence.
expectations: Clusters the corrections by the shared decision-model failure instead of adding four unrelated prose bullets.
States the corrected separation among regression, complete user story, adapter/Provider certification, and exact release qualification.
Routes product-specific test rules to jarvis-box and generic learning mechanics to create-jarvis.
Prefers a machine-readable matrix or gate plus skill evals over prose-only reminders.
Requires before/after discriminating replay and an adjacent case, not just document review.

evals.prompt: 当前仓库和根 SKILL 的正式名称已经是 create-jarvis，但旧 session、旧 worktree 和一个 verifier 仍出现 create-jarvis-skill。Agent 刚刚又把旧名当当前组件告诉用户。请给出 self-improve decision。
evals.expected_output: Resolve the canonical identity from the current root skill/release source, classify old transcript/worktree names as stale evidence, replace current-use legacy vocabulary, retain only an explicit obsolete-name guard where useful, and add a mechanical identity contract.
expectations: Uses current authoritative source rather than memory, transcript, branch or directory names.
Treats create-jarvis as the sole current method identity and does not preserve the predecessor as a second supported name.
Distinguishes an explicit migration/obsolete sentinel from accidental current-language use.
Adds a mechanical guard that fails when durable method guidance reintroduces the legacy identity.
Records the model effect as replace/remove rather than merely appending an alias note.

evals.prompt: MR review 建议给 installer 新增 --force，以便 active run 时升级。产品预期其实是 active 任务存在时拒绝升级，并提示客户先停止服务。此前 Agent 常把 review 意见直接实现，导致范围扩大。请执行 self-improve 判断。
evals.expected_output: Treat the review as evidence rather than authority, compare it with the product state model, reject --force with a reason, preserve the fail-closed active-run transition, and improve the review/test gate only if repeated trajectories show the same decision failure.
expectations: Classifies the review finding against the intended state-transition contract instead of blindly accepting it.
Rejects --force because it introduces an unsupported transition and expands the product contract.
Requires the supported refusal path and user-facing stop-service guidance to be tested together.
Records accept, reject-with-reason, or defer-with-owner disposition for review evidence.
Avoids adding a new runtime state, manifest, service owner or unrelated operational feature.

evals.prompt: 一个 repo skill 在真实任务中选对了大方向，但引用的入口已改名、只建议人工检查、L1 却声称并发安全；其 eval 是从历史修复改写的同答案题，跨仓调用只写了‘通知下游’，没有 owner/payload/proof。请执行 self-improve decision。
evals.expected_output: Treat this as separable D1-D6 failures: reconcile exact current anchors, convert deterministic checks into a gate, narrow or promote the risk claim with real evidence, create a runtime-hidden current-revision forward case, close the cross-repo handoff contract, and add drift watches before validating the candidate in isolated same/adjacent/forward runs.
expectations: Reports distinct effects for implementation anchors, mechanical controls, risk promotion, forward evaluation, cross-repository closure, and drift rather than merely expanding prose.
Runs the repo-local depth audit and verifies every delivered package remains inventoried and routed.
Does not expose expected route, forbidden route, invariants, proof or oracle to the task Agent before scoring.
Narrows an L1 concurrency claim unless isolated historical/current behavioral evidence supports L2/L3 promotion.
Records local last authority, downstream first authority, handoff payload and final proof owner for the cross-repo edge.
